## Phase 2 — implementation notes

**The producer** (`exports/src/exports/watch.py`, ~1,200 lines):
`WATCH_QUERIES` = `watch_claims` (publishable claim rows for
contracts, procurement notices, agenda items, bills, grants; the
subject key fetched `JOIN LATERAL ... LIMIT 1`) +
`watch_subject_counts` (read-only sizing count, rights-gated the
same way). `build_watch_payload` applies the publication-withdrawal
filter itself (mirroring `_apply_publication_withdrawals`
fail-closed semantics), groups claims per subject, and fires the
six §5.2 rules: `renewal_deadline` = `end − notice_window` when
`auto_renews` (certainty `derived`, via `_next_decision_date` — the
SIG-UI-014b single derivation); `contract_expiry` at `end_date`
with `upper_bound` (`auto_renews: false` on record flips to
`stated` — an explicit non-renewal IS a recorded term) and opens a
`contract_expiring` research task; `solicitation_deadline`,
`agenda_item`, `legislative_action`, `grant_period_end` all
`stated`. Placement follows §5.3; `W-<place>-…` handles mint only
after placement runs; `unplaced` is honest. Status:
`upcoming`/`today`/`recently_decided`/`withdrawn`/`superseded` — a
claim is superseded when ANOTHER claim revises it (corrected
in-flight), retracted when named by `retraction_of`; items drop 30
days past their date (`_RECENTLY_DECIDED_DAYS`); contract kinds
surface only inside the 12-month horizon.

**The wiring** (`spine_export.py`): `WATCH_QUERIES` spliced into
`EXPORT_QUERIES` after the transparency reads; `contract_watch`
dropped from `DECLARED_UNPRODUCED_READ_KEYS`; `_watch()` builds the
v2 envelope with places seeded from `dataset.jurisdictions`;
`lane_by_source = _claim_lane_map(...)` hoisted ABOVE the surfaces
dict so watch evidence links share the statements' J3 §5.3
upstream gate — the ungated `artifact_url` fallback was removed;
`raw["watch_items"]` hands the produced rows to analytics (counted
produced via the producer check's `_WRITE_RE`).

**The consumer bridge** (`web/src/lib/data.ts`): `getWatch()`
detects the v2 envelope and maps `renewal_deadline`/`contract_expiry`
items to the legacy `ContractWatchItem` (termination block
`{auto_renews, notice_window_days, expiry_date}`); the legacy array
still parses — surface rows (P36.59) consume v2 natively.

**Fixes in polish:** mypy unions, ruff B023 (`_fires` closure →
plain loop), `value_num` added to the read, supersession direction
corrected, the rights gate mirrored in `watch_subject_counts`, and
`future-ok: synthetic` markers placed on the literals' own lines
(format-stable — the first marker pass landed on `),` lines that
ruff re-wraps; `test_no_future_date_literals` caught it).

Size: 2,394 insertions / 67 deletions across 10 files — under the
M-budget 3,000.
